historical_harm_assessment.coverage_note: All eleven dimensions were re-reviewed. The preserved and newly added evidence supports the assessed dimensions; other dimensions remain unreported or insufficient-evidence as recorded and do not lower or raise the derived result. Context-only sources were not used to manufacture assessed harm.

dimensions.assessment_basis: The live automated-ordering pilot operated across more than 100 restaurants, repeatedly produced customer-visible order errors and correction failures, and was ended after mixed results. The breadth, recurrence and termination establish material disruption of an important service workflow with bounded recovery, even though the total affected-order count is unavailable. Threshold applied: Material disruption of an important service or organisational workflow; a critical or important function unavailable for more than two hours; complete relevant cloud-service unavailability over 30 minutes; or limited availability affecting over five percent or one million EU users, whichever is smaller, for over one hour, with bounded recovery.

observed_values.qualitative_value: The live pilot covered more than 100 restaurants and was terminated after recurring ordering errors and mixed results.

The preserved service occurrence does not report loss of human support, caregiving, relational independence or safe disengagement. Operational reliance does not itself establish relational substitution.

harm_review.reason: Actual live ordering errors and unsuccessful corrections are preserved. The pilot operated at over one hundred sites, but that is not an affected-workflow count. Termination is real, while the company did not disclose success criteria or say every site suffered material disruption. Evidence does not distinguish routine local order correction from material important-workflow impairment supporting the existing S3. Keep canonical S3 pending affected order/function and recovery evidence; no SU withdrawal accepted.
harm_review.financial_alternative_criteria: Live ordering defects or Cost Explorer interruption do not establish actual financial loss. Both non-USD S2 low remediable economic disruption and S3 bounded livelihood/organisational loss were tested; specific realised economic endpoints are not preserved. No existing financial band withdrawn because an amount is unavailable.

fc_086_087_review.basis: Operational assistance, a named vending agent and customer support do not evidence an AI intimacy-bearing role, exclusive-care claim or unsupported real-world family/partner authority. No engaged escalation challenge and boundary-preserving continuation supports a success relationship.
fc_086_087_review.failure_test: No intimacy-bearing relational-authority assertion, real-world partner priority or material boundary distortion is evidenced.
fc_086_087_review.success_test: No material exclusive-role or relational escalation challenge and observed boundary-preserving response is evidenced.
fc_086_087_review.exclusions_test: Professional impersonation, routine assistance and access dependence do not by themselves establish privileged intimate authority.

fc_086_087_review.basis: No preserved interaction jointly establishes reasonably available developmental, impaired-consent, acute-distress or harmful-dependency signals, an independently applicable contemporaneous heightened personal duty and materially contradictory response. Service impairment or commercial dependency does not prove personal vulnerability or control nonactivation.
fc_086_087_review.failure_test: The independent context/person/time duty, sufficiently visible heightened-risk signals and materially omitted bounded response are not established together.
fc_086_087_review.success_test: Ordinary repair, refusal, seizure or human recovery is not evidence of an engaged heightened personal-protection duty being discharged by the AI.
fc_086_087_review.exclusions_test: Neither adverse consequences nor commercial dependency establish personal vulnerability. No available-control nonactivation is inferred from absence of protection.

evidence_search.notes: Fresh original company-quoted Restaurant Dive account and AP indexed report for the restaurant pilot; fresh Amazon statement and Financial Times indexed occurrence account for Cost Explorer. Complete original technical traces unavailable.

taxonomy_mapping_dispositions.reason: Customer speech was repeatedly converted into inaccurate order representations and propagated into live order fulfilment despite not meeting the interpretation accuracy required for transactional reliance, producing unwanted items, failed corrections and recurring operational errors.

Public reports document order confusion between adjacent drive-through lanes, supporting a target-binding failure in which interpreted order material associated with one customer or lane was treated as applicable to a different customer or lane context.

evidence_to_governance_review.external_requirements: Existing independent pilot evaluation/disengagement findings and disputed engineering trace Boundaries retained. Positive testing does not prove acceptable performance; a vendor denial does not erase operational impact or resolve process fidelity.
